# Raks — Lingerie & Nightwear in Pakistan

> Raks (https://raks.pk) is Pakistan's online store for premium women's lingerie, bras, nightwear, pyjamas, panties and shapewear — designed for comfort, confidence and everyday elegance. All prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR / Rs). Cash on Delivery is available nationwide, with free delivery on orders over Rs 3,000.

## Shop
- [All Products](https://raks.pk/shop/): The full Raks catalogue (200+ products)
- [Nightdress & Nightwear](https://raks.pk/product-category/lingerie/nightwear/): Nighties, night suits, nightgowns, sexy/bridal/luxury nightwear, fabric-based night dresses
- [Bras](https://raks.pk/product-category/lingerie/bras/): T-shirt, push-up, padded, non-padded, sports, bralette, minimizer, nursing & maternity, bridal, fancy bras and bra sets
- [Pyjama Sets](https://raks.pk/product-category/lingerie/pyjama/): Cotton, silk and satin pyjama sets and loungewear
- [Panties](https://raks.pk/product-category/lingerie/panties/): Briefs, hipsters and panty sets
- [Body Shaper](https://raks.pk/product-category/lingerie/shapewear/): Shapewear and body shapers

- [Sitemap](https://raks.pk/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable list of every product, category and article URL
